source_artifacts.gici_rtk.yaml:
stream:
  streamers:
  - streamer:
      tag: str_gnss_rov_file
      type: post-file
      path: results/GICI-RTK/run_20260911T011344Z/inputs/rover_cut.obs
      format:
        type: gnss-rinex
      latency: 0.0
  - streamer:
      tag: str_gnss_ref_file
      type: post-file
      path: results/GICI-RTK/run_20260911T011344Z/inputs/base_cut.obs
      format:
        type: gnss-rinex
  - streamer:
      tag: str_gnss_eph_file
      type: post-file
      path: data/tex_cup/brdm1290.19p
      burst_load: true
      format:
        type: gnss-rinex
  - streamer:
      tag: str_rtk_solution_file
      input_tags:
      - fmt_rtk_solution_file
      type: file
      path: results/GICI-RTK/run_20260911T011344Z/solution.nmea
      enable_time_tag: false
  formators:
  - formator:
      io: output
      tag: fmt_rtk_solution_file
      type: nmea
      use_gga: true
      use_rmc: false
      use_esa: true
      use_esd: true
      talker_id: GP
  replay:
    enable: true
    start_offset: 0.0
estimate:
- estimator:
    tag: est_rtk
    type: rtk
    input_tags:
    - str_gnss_rov_file
    - str_gnss_ref_file
    - str_gnss_eph_file
    str_gnss_rov_file_roles:
    - rover
    str_gnss_ref_file_roles:
    - reference
    str_gnss_eph_file_roles:
    - ephemeris
    output_tags:
    - fmt_rtk_solution_file
    output_align_tag: str_gnss_rov_file
    compute_covariance: true
    rtk_options:
      max_window_length: 3
      use_ambiguity_resolution: true
      estimate_velocity: true
    gnss_estimator_base_options:
      gnss_common:
        system_exclude:
        - R
        code_exclude:
        - G|2L
        - E|5Q
        min_elevation: 12.0
        min_SNR:
        - 35.0
        - 30.0
        mw_slip_thres: 0.5
        gf_slip_thres: 0.05
        gf_sd_slip_thres: 0.05
      use_outlier_rejection: true
      max_pesudorange_error: 4.0
      max_phaserange_error: 0.06
      max_doppler_error: 0.5
    estimator_base_options:
      max_iteration: 5
      num_threads: 2
      max_solver_time: 0.02
      verbose_output: false
      solver_type: dense_schur
      trust_region_strategy_type: dogleg
      log_intermediate_data: true
      log_intermediate_data_directory: results/GICI-RTK/run_20260911T011344Z/logs
    ambiguity_resolution_options:
      system_exclude:
      - R
      min_percentage_fixation_uwl: 1.0
      min_percentage_fixation_wl: 0.9
      min_percentage_fixation_nl: 0.9
      ratio: 2.0
logging:
  enable: true
  min_log_level: 0
  log_to_stderr: true
  file_directory: results/GICI-RTK/run_20260911T011344Z/logs

path_convention: Paths within the benchmark are relative to the repository root. TEX-CUP input paths refer to data/tex_cup. Angle-bracket environment, home and temporary roots are symbolic references, not executable paths. Source run paths identify the original generated runs; those runtime directories need not be distributed with the saved results. Scientific configuration, coordinate/time rules and run status are retained.
